newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bonds underperform, junk closes lower.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bonds underperform, junk closes lower.

text.p: U.S. corporate investment grade bonds underperformed U.S. Treasuries in light trade with spreads widening one to three basis points, while junk bonds closed lower, dealers said.
The bank and finance sector was active in an otherwise quiet session with Mellon Bank pricing two tranches of new debt totalling $350 million and recently priced bank debt falling in secondary trade.
Mellon priced $250 million in 11-year, A2/A rated subordinated notes via Morgan Stanley & Co Inc at 7.666 percent or 71 basis points over comparable Treasuries.
